key_reasoning.reason: Removes the dedicated MS Teams Bot admin subsystem (TeamsBotPage, TeamsBotProjectPage, AddAssistantModal, assistantsProjectMapping store/type) and re-wires the feature through the shared Integrations/SettingsForm flow — new abstractions (assistantMultiSelect field type, useResourceOptions hook) plus edits to core shared utilities (settings.ts, settingsUIConfig.ts) used by every credential type.

Two compounding risk factors: (1) a data-model migration moving assistant_ids from a dedicated store/type into generic credential_values via a new msTeamsSettings util, and (2) the affected credential type is guarded by ADMIN_ONLY role restriction and PROJECT_ONLY access type, i.e. an authorization-sensitive integration.

Diffstat reports 32 files changed (149 insertions, 1222 deletions) spanning routing, constants, store, types, utils, and pages/integrations + pages/settings/administration — well past the 16+ XXL threshold, dominated by deletions consistent with a consolidation/removal of the standalone admin pages.

red_flags_applied: Component Scope bumped (capped at XXL): 'refactor/migrate large subsystem' — TeamsBot admin pages and store folded into the generic Integrations/SettingsForm flow, touching core shared utilities.

Technical Risk bumped further: 'affects authentication or authorization' — MS Teams credential type is ADMIN_ONLY / PROJECT_ONLY restricted.
